text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bomb explodes in market frequented mostly by women, killing five people in Bou Haroun near Algiers.
- Joint committees on political reforms end work.
- Foreign Minister Attaf says Algeria is more than a market for France.
- Economic and social council holds sixth session in presence of government head Ahmed Ouyahia to underline government strategy on issues including industrial policy and housing.
- Banned Islamic Salvation Front leader Abassi Madani's two sons tried in Germany on charges of smuggling arms and explosives.
